scope: annual detection-sensitive fallback; sampling-effort-stratified response holdout

ecological_interpretation.gain: The numerical full-model gain skill is reproducible but cannot be interpreted as an outcome-independent ecological-filter result because non-zero published phenological overlap is nested entirely within dyads that are observed as links at least once over 2006-2011.
ecological_interpretation.loss: The loss endpoint remains descriptive only. Removing phenology leaves modest primary discrimination (AUC 0.5995; relative log-loss reduction 0.0131) and one of three primary folds has negative proper-score skill.
ecological_interpretation.routeability: No routeability or decision-equivalence inference is supported.

next_gate: freeze an independent decision-structure exposure, then compare conventional-only versus conventional-plus-decision models using the same temporal holdout scopes; the decision layer must improve held-out performance without being derived from the network response
claim_ceiling: Historical held-out numerical performance only. The full-model gain result is quarantined for ecological-filter interpretation by validation/villavicencio_phenology_support_leakage_v1.json; it is not evidence for prospective forecasting, causal filtering, or routeability.

time_support.not_held_out: full temporal support used to construct phenological overlap and flower abundance
time_support.interpretation: held-out annual-link discrimination, not strict prospective forecasting

historical_ecological_interpretation.primary: independently measured phenology, abundance and raw morphology carry reproducible information about both link formation and link loss across held-out annual transitions
historical_ecological_interpretation.asymmetry: the conventional-filter baseline discriminates held-out annual link gains substantially better than losses in the sampling-consistent primary scope
historical_ecological_interpretation.residual_opportunity: predictive improvement is incomplete for both endpoints, leaving a well-defined residual target for any later independent decision-structure layer
not_established: incremental value of decision structure beyond conventional filters
strict prospective forecasting from past-only covariates

supersession.required_next_step: reconstruct outcome-independent opportunity/phenology from raw dated records before any gain-filter promotion
